name: Repeated texture-quality comparison with no-defragment enabled
primary_metric: Native after-physics callback intervals >50 ms per minute, excluding initial five seconds after unpause
secondary_metrics: Intervals >25 ms and >100 ms per minute
replication_unit: Fresh simulator process, not individual frames
acceptance: Both complete flights pass existing pacing validity, exact source/configuration controls and verified restoration; landing precision assessed separately. Preserve every error. Any unexpected failure stops progression for inspection and existing recovery.
baseline_reproduction: Maximum textures must produce >50 ms pauses in at least two fresh processes to support a useful mitigation comparison

controls.presentation: Unchanged saved NVIDIA application profile, no temporary DXGI override

cache_treatment: Retain evolving disk and OS caches; alternating AB/BA/AB ordering, not cold-cache trials
stopping_rule: Complete all six planned valid processes unless safety, validity or user interruption requires stopping. Do not stop early for a favorable result or silently discard a failure.
final_settings: Restore original maximum textures, flag on, cache 10 GB, HAGS unchanged

excluded_attempts.reason: Startup remained at Flight Configuration/main menu; no measured flights; requested cancellation, then existing exact-process recovery
